item.title: New Team Xray XB4 Slipper Eliminator One Way Set
item.description: Team Xray has specially designed slipper eliminator set for XB4 stock class racing, combining the efficiency of a solid axle on-power with the drivability benefits of a one-way system off-power.

item.title: New Kyosho MP11e 1/8th Electric Buggy Kit
item.description: Based on the newly redesigned Kyosho Inferno MP11 GP buggy, the MP11e is far more than an electric conversion.

item.title: New VP-Pro 1/10th Scale Buggy Wing
item.description: VP-Pro is excited to launch their new 1/10 Buggy Clear Wing, WN-017, intended for use with 1/10th off-road vehicles.

item.title: Ultimate Racing DNC Race Report
item.description: This year’s Dirt Nitro Challenge at The Dirt in Perris, CA was nothing short of spectacular for Ultimate Racing—the brand continues to set the standard in performance, power, and consistency.

item.title: Frechette Joins Power HD
item.description: Canadian touring car talent Bryce Frechette powers forward with the Power HD GTS-2X servo.

item.title: New Serpent SRX8GT-R 2-Piece Chassis
item.description: Elevate your racing with the ultimate chassis upgrade for the Serpent SRX8GT R. Engineered for drivers who demand precision, this high-performance plate is designed to unlock a new level of handling and consistency.

item.title: New Sworkz Mugen and Sworkz Rear Hub Weights
item.description: RC Project has released new 5g and 10g hub weights for the Sworkz S35 series buggies and Truggies and the Mugen Seiki MBX8 series buggies and truggies. These attach to the carbon extension on the hubs and allow for further weight tuning.

item.title: Donathen RC Now Carries SMC Batteries
item.description: Donathen RC will now be carrying the full line of SMC ROAR Legal 2S battery packs on the Donathen RC online store.

item.title: New Moto-Obscura Vintage Spring Rates
item.description: Vintage racing specialists Moto-Obscura have released two reproduction spring rates for vintage Losi vehicles.

item.title: Hobbywing Stock Spec Speed Run With Rivkin and Gonzales [VIDEO]
item.description: This week Spencer Rivkin and Matthew Gonzales demonstrate how fast the spec 17.5 2wd cars can go. The famous question “How fast does it go."
